quote_verbatim: NbS have been used for stormwater management by combining water purification and retention functions. In summary, there is growing evidence on NbS effectiveness as an adaptation measure and its critical role for transformative adaptation to address climate change water-related hazards and water security (medium evidence, high agreement).
